statement: Let J_0,J_1,J_2,J_3 be independent uniform elements of {0,1,2,3}, let D={i:J_i=0}, and let Z=|D|. Then E[Z]=1. An independent uniform I satisfies Pr(I in D)=1/4. If instead I is uniform in D conditional on D being nonempty, and uniform in all four columns when D is empty, each marginal Pr(I=i) remains 1/4, but Pr(I in D)=175/256. Thus uniform marginals alone do not imply Pr(I in D)=E[Z]/4.
why_needed: Makes the independence hypothesis behind the eq-19 equality explicit and supplies a finite discriminating control.
route_note: Derived explanatory control. Ordinary symmetry/probability argument plus exact rational enumeration of 256 worlds; no new Lean theorem. Its changed sampling law is not the preprint experiment.

statement: For the total one-bit identity f(x)=x, there is no input-independent randomized program of worst-case depth zero that succeeds with probability at least 2/3 on both inputs.
why_needed: Detects reversal of algorithm/input quantifiers and loss of input-independence.
route_note: Ordinary two-output-mass contradiction; proposed actual-definition proof.

statement: For total two-bit OR, the equal mixture of constant true, reading bit 0, and reading bit 1 has worst-case depth at most one and success probabilities (2/3,2/3,2/3,1) on inputs (00,01,10,11). Consequently R(OR_2)=1. The specified mixture fails a strictly-greater-than-2/3 requirement.
why_needed: Tests the inclusive threshold and query cap without asserting an unproved strict-threshold lower bound.
route_note: Direct finite mixture calculation and both-label zero-query impossibility; proposed actual-definition proofs.

statement: Let g on one bit be defined only at input 1, with value true. A constant-true zero-query algorithm computes g, and the actual models satisfy R(g)=Q(g)=0.
route_note: Explicit classical and ConstantOnPromise witnesses; no empty-infimum argument.

statement: For k=2, t=1 and m=4, with both sign vectors (-1,1,1,1), the actual Forrelation numerator is -8, denominator is 8 and Phi=-1; the signed high branch and absolute low branch both fail, so P is undefined.
why_needed: Detects replacing the signed high branch by an absolute-value high branch.
route_note: Finite Walsh-matrix calculation; proposed actual-definition proof recomputes the known supplied Sanity example. No novelty claim.

statement: For two candidates, the real matrix a has zero diagonal and off-diagonal entries 1/2 and satisfies the actual Tournament.IsComparison predicate. The deliberately shared variant with an additional impossible:False field has no witness.
why_needed: Exposes shared vacuity that a matching challenge/solution pair would not exclude.
route_note: Explicit actual-model witness plus false elimination for an intentionally altered predicate. Proposed Lean; native comparison acceptance is predicted, not observed.

statement: A tree that queries the same coordinate twice has path [q,q] and depth two on every input. If q is a designated zero in the independently specified dummy experiment, the distinct discovered-column count is one.
why_needed: Tests the shared path/depth interface and distinguishes queries from discoveries.
route_note: Direct structural evaluation and singleton-cardinality argument; proposed Lean, uncompiled.
